detail: Acquisition - Mayur Uniquoters Ltd has informed the Exchange about Approval of  the Investment upto the amount of Rs. 191.40 lakhs (Rupees One Ninety-One Lakhs and Forty Thousand Only) in one or more tranches by way of subscribing to the 26% Equity Share of Bhadla Mini Grid Solar 6 Pvt. Ltd, Associate Company
